function.name: debugstr_composition
function.description: This function checks if the composition is null, if it is, it returns '(null)'. If not, it returns a formatted string that includes the style, current position, and area of the composition.

parameters.name: composition

function.return_type: char: Returns a string that represents the composition's style, current position, and area or '(null)' if the composition is null.

parameters.description: This is a pointer to a CANDIDATEFORM object whose details are to be formatted into a string.

function.name: ime_is_unicode
function.description: This function checks if the input method editor (IME) is in unicode mode.

parameters.name: ime
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the IME structure that is being checked.

function.return_type: BOOL, returns TRUE if the IME is in unicode mode, FALSE otherwise.

function.name: input_context_is_unicode
function.description: This function checks if the input context is unicode or not.

parameters.name: ctx
parameters.description: This parameter is used to represent the input context.

function.return_type: BOOL, returns true if the input context is unicode, false otherwise.

function.name: strdupAtoW

parameters.name: str
parameters.description: This is the ASCII string that needs to be converted to wide character format.

function.name: strdupWtoA
function.description: This function converts a wide character string to a multi-byte string.

parameters.name: str
parameters.description: This is the wide character string that needs to be converted.

function.description: This function converts a candidate list from ASCII to wide characters.

parameters.name: lpDst
parameters.description: Destination candidate list in wide character format

function.name: get_thread_coinit_spy
function.description: This function retrieves the coinit_spy structure associated with the current thread.
function.return_type: struct coinit_spy - a pointer to the coinit_spy structure associated with the current thread

function.name: imm_couninit_thread
function.description: This function handles the implicit COM deinitialization and cleanup of a thread if certain conditions are met.

parameters.name: cleanup
parameters.description: This parameter determines whether the function should perform cleanup operations or not.

function.return_type: void, this function does not return any value.

function.name: impl_from_IInitializeSpy
function.description: This function returns a pointer to a coinit_spy structure that contains the given IInitializeSpy interface.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an IInitializeSpy interface

function.return_type: Pointer to struct coinit_spy. It represents the containing record of the given IInitializeSpy interface.

function.name: InitializeSpy_QueryInterface
function.description: This function checks if the provided interface ID matches the ID of IInitializeSpy or IUnknown. If it does, it increases the reference count of the interface and returns S_OK. If it doesn't, it returns E_NOINTERFACE.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IInitializeSpy interface

parameters.name: riid
parameters.description: Reference to the interface ID to be checked

parameters.name: obj

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. S_OK if the interface ID matches, E_NOINTERFACE otherwise

function.name: InitializeSpy_AddRef
function.description: This function increments the reference count of the IInitializeSpy interface.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IInitializeSpy interface whose reference count is to be incremented.

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the new reference count after incrementing.

function.name: InitializeSpy_Release
function.description: This function decrements the reference count of the IInitializeSpy interface. If the reference count becomes zero, it frees the memory allocated to the spy and sets the client_imm of the current thread to zero.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This parameter is a pointer to the IInitializeSpy interface whose reference count is to be decremented.

function.return_type: ULONG, which represents the new reference count after decrementing.

function.name: InitializeSpy_PreInitialize
function.description: This function pre-initializes a spy object, checks if certain conditions are met, and if so, modifies the spy object's flags and calls a function to uninitialize a thread.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an IInitializeSpy interface

parameters.name: coinit
parameters.description: A set of flags that specify the concurrency model used for the call to the CoInitializeEx function

parameters.name: refs
parameters.description: The number of references to the object

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the result of the function, S_OK if the function succeeds

function.name: InitializeSpy_PostInitialize
function.description: This function modifies the HRESULT based on certain conditions and updates the apt_flags of the coinit_spy structure.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an IInitializeSpy interface

parameters.name: hr
parameters.description: The result of a previous operation

parameters.name: coinit
parameters.description: A value representing the initialization of the Component Object Model (COM) library

parameters.name: refs
parameters.description: The number of active references

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the modified result of the operation

function.name: InitializeSpy_PreUninitialize
function.description: This function is a stub, it does not perform any action and always returns S_OK.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an IInitializeSpy interface

parameters.name: refs
parameters.description: A 32-bit unsigned integer

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the result of the function, always returns S_OK in this case

function.name: InitializeSpy_PostUninitialize
function.description: This function checks the reference count and the status of the default input method editor (IME) window. If the reference count is 1 and there is no default IME window, it uninitializes the thread. If the reference count is 0, it updates the apartment threading flags to indicate that it can't be freed.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Interface pointer used to get the implementation of IInitializeSpy

parameters.name: refs
parameters.description: The reference count

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. Returns S_OK if the operation is successful

function.name: init_ole32_funcs
function.description: This function initializes the ole32 functions by getting the module handle of 'ole32' and assigning the addresses of 'CoRevokeInitializeSpy' and 'CoUninitialize' functions to the respective pointers.

parameters.name: once
parameters.description: Pointer to an INIT_ONCE structure that the function uses to determine whether to perform the initialization.

parameters.name: param
parameters.description: This parameter is not used in the function and can be any value.

parameters.name: context
parameters.description: This parameter is not used in the function and can be any value.

function.return_type: BOOL, returns TRUE after successfully initializing the ole32 functions.

function.name: imm_coinit_thread
function.description: This function initializes a COM thread. It checks if the thread has already been initialized or is broken, and if not, it registers an InitializeSpy, initializes the COM library and sets the thread as created.

parameters.name: void
parameters.description: This function does not take any parameters.

function.return_type: void, this function does not return a value.

function.name: query_imc_data
function.description: This function queries the input method context (IMC) data associated with a given handle. If the handle is null or if the handle does not match the handle in the returned IMC structure, the function returns null.

parameters.name: handle
parameters.description: This is the handle for which the IMC data is queried.

function.return_type: struct imc*. It represents the pointer to the IMC data structure associated with the given handle. If the handle is null or does not match the handle in the returned IMC structure, the function returns null.

function.name: find_ime_from_hkl
function.description: This function searches through a list of IME structures and returns the one that matches the given HKL value. If no match is found, it returns NULL.

parameters.name: hkl
parameters.description: This parameter is the HKL value that the function is searching for in the list of IME structures.

function.return_type: struct ime*. This represents the IME structure that matches the given HKL value. If no match is found, the function returns NULL.

function.name: ImmFreeLayout
function.description: This function is used to free the layout of an Input Method Editor (IME). It removes the IME from the list, destroys the IME, and frees the associated memory.

parameters.name: hkl
parameters.description: This parameter is a handle to the keyboard layout.

function.return_type: BOOL, returns TRUE if the operation is successful, otherwise returns FALSE.

function.name: ImmLoadIME
function.description: This function loads an Input Method Editor (IME) module and initializes the IME function pointers. If the IME module fails to load, it falls back to a default IME.

parameters.name: hkl
parameters.description: Handle to the input locale identifier

function.return_type: BOOL, returns TRUE if the IME module is successfully loaded and initialized, otherwise returns FALSE

function.name: ime_acquire
function.description: This function acquires an IME (Input Method Editor) structure based on the given HKL (Handle to Keyboard Layout). It increases the reference count of the IME if it exists.

parameters.name: hkl
parameters.description: Handle to Keyboard Layout. Used to load the IME and find it in the system.

function.return_type: struct ime*. Returns a pointer to the acquired IME structure, or NULL if the IME could not be loaded.

function.name: ime_release
function.description: This function decreases the reference count of the given IME (Input Method Editor) object. If the reference count reaches zero and the IME object has the IME_PROP_END_UNLOAD property set, it frees the layout associated with the IME object.

parameters.name: ime
parameters.description: Pointer to the IME object whose reference count is to be decreased.

function.return_type: void, this function does not return a value

function.name: ime_save_input_context
function.description: This function saves the input context in the IME. It creates a default input context and copies the old context into it. It then creates a new IMC entry and adds it to the IME's input context list. If the list was previously empty, it increments the IME's reference count.

parameters.name: ime
parameters.description: Pointer to the IME structure

parameters.name: himc
parameters.description: Handle to the input context

parameters.name: ctx
parameters.description: Pointer to the input context to be saved

function.return_type: void, this function does not return a value

function.name: ime_find_input_context
function.description: This function is used to find an input context in a given IME structure. It iterates over the input contexts of the IME, and returns the one that matches the provided HIMC. If no match is found, it returns NULL.

parameters.name: ime
parameters.description: Pointer to the IME structure to search in

parameters.name: himc
parameters.description: The HIMC to match in the input contexts of the IME

function.return_type: INPUTCONTEXT*. It represents the input context that matches the provided HIMC. If no match is found, NULL is returned.

function.name: imc_release_ime
function.description: This function releases the input method context (IMC) and the input method editor (IME). It destroys the window associated with the IMC, sets the ui_hwnd to NULL, deselects the IME, updates the input context if it exists, and finally releases the IME.

parameters.name: imc
parameters.description: Pointer to the input method context (IMC) to be released

parameters.name: ime
parameters.description: Pointer to the input method editor (IME) to be released

function.return_type: void, this function does not return anything

function.name: imc_select_ime
function.description: This function selects an Input Method Editor (IME) based on the current keyboard layout, releases the previous IME if it doesn't match the current one, acquires a new IME if necessary, finds or saves the input context, and selects the IME for the input method context.

parameters.name: imc
parameters.description: Pointer to an imc structure which represents the input method context.

function.return_type: struct ime*; represents a pointer to the selected IME structure.

function.name: enum_activate_layout
function.description: This function locks and immediately unlocks the input context, essentially doing nothing but returning true.

parameters.name: himc
parameters.description: Handle to the input context.

parameters.name: lparam
parameters.description: Additional message-specific information.

function.return_type: BOOL, represents the success of the function. Always returns TRUE in this case.

function.name: ImmActivateLayout
function.description: This function activates a specific keyboard layout, and enumerates the input context.

parameters.name: hkl
parameters.description: This parameter represents the handle to the keyboard layout to be activated.

function.return_type: BOOL, returns TRUE if the keyboard layout is successfully activated, otherwise returns FALSE.

function.name: free_input_context_data
function.description: This function frees the input context data associated with a given HIMC handle. It first queries the input method context data, then selects and releases the input method editor (IME) if one is associated with the data. It then destroys various components of the input method context before finally freeing the data itself.

parameters.name: hIMC
parameters.description: Handle to the input method context whose data is to be freed.

function.return_type: BOOL, returns TRUE if the operation is successful, FALSE otherwise.

function.name: input_context_init
function.description: This function initializes an input context, allocating and setting up necessary structures such as COMPOSITIONSTRING, CANDIDATEINFO, GUIDELINE and an array of candidate forms.

parameters.name: ctx
parameters.description: A pointer to the input context to be initialized.

function.return_type: void, this function does not return a value.

function.name: IMM_FreeThreadData
function.description: This function frees the input context data of the current thread and releases the IInitializeSpy interface if it exists.

parameters.name: None
parameters.description: This function does not take any parameters.

function.return_type: void, this function does not return any value.

function.name: IMM_FreeAllImmHkl
function.description: This function iterates over a list of IME (Input Method Editor) structures and frees the memory allocated to each of them. It also destroys the associated input context and frees the memory allocated to it.

parameters.name: void
parameters.description: This function does not take any parameters.

function.return_type: void, this function does not return anything.

function.name: DllMain
function.description: This function is an entry point to a DLL. It is called by the system when processes and threads are initialized and terminated, or upon using LoadLibrary and FreeLibrary. It initializes the User32 Imm entry table, sets the imm32 module to the instance, and frees thread data and all Imm HKLs upon process detach.

parameters.name: instance
parameters.description: Handle to the DLL module. The value is the base address of the DLL.

parameters.name: reason
parameters.description: Indicates why the DLL entry-point function is being called.

parameters.name: reserved
parameters.description: If the reason is DLL_PROCESS_DETACH, reserved is used to indicate if the DLL is being unloaded or the process is terminating.

function.return_type: BOOL. Returns TRUE if successful or FALSE otherwise.

function.name: ImmSetActiveContext
function.description: This function sets the active input method context for a given window and input method context. It also sends a message to the window to update the UI and sets the last error to 0.

parameters.name: hwnd
parameters.description: Handle to the window for which the input method context is to be set.

parameters.name: himc
parameters.description: Handle to the input method context.

parameters.name: activate
parameters.description: Boolean value that indicates whether to activate or deactivate the input method context.

function.return_type: BOOL. Returns TRUE if the function successfully sets the active input method context, otherwise returns FALSE.

function.name: ImmConfigureIMEA
function.description: This function is used to configure the Input Method Editor (IME). It checks the mode and data parameters, acquires the IME, and then calls the IME's configuration function. If the mode is IME_CONFIG_REGISTERWORD and the IME is Unicode, it also converts the word and reading from ASCII to wide characters before calling the configuration function.

parameters.name: hkl
parameters.description: Handle to the input locale identifier

parameters.name: hwnd
parameters.description: Handle to the parent window

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: Specifies the action to be performed

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: Pointer to the data to be configured

function.return_type: BOOL, represents whether the function was successful or not

function.name: ImmConfigureIMEW
function.description: This function is used to configure the Input Method Editor (IME).

parameters.name: hkl
parameters.description: A handle to the input locale identifier

parameters.name: hwnd
parameters.description: A handle to the window for which the IME is to be configured

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: The mode of configuration

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: A pointer to the configuration data

function.return_type: BOOL, represents whether the IME was successfully configured or not

function.name: create_input_context
function.description: This function creates a new input context, initializes it, and updates or creates a handle for it based on the default input context provided. If the handle is not created, it frees the input context data and returns 0.

parameters.name: default_imc
parameters.description: This is the default input method context (IMC) that is used to create or update the new context's handle.

function.return_type: Returns a pointer to the new input context of type 'struct imc'. If the handle is not created, it returns 0.

function.name: get_imc_data
function.description: This function queries IMC data using a given handle. If the query fails or the handle is null, it creates a new input context using the handle.

parameters.name: handle
parameters.description: Handle to the IMC data

function.return_type: struct imc pointer, represents the queried IMC data or a newly created input context

function.name: default_input_context
function.description: This function retrieves the default input context for the current thread, creates one if it doesn't exist, and returns the associated data.
function.return_type: struct imc*, represents the data associated with the default input context of the current thread

function.name: get_ime_ui_window
function.description: This function gets the window handle of the Input Method Editor (IME) user interface. If the window does not exist, it creates one.
function.return_type: HWND, which represents the handle to the IME user interface window

function.name: set_ime_ui_window_himc
function.description: This function sets the Input Method Editor (IME) user interface window handle context.

parameters.name: himc
parameters.description: Handle to the input context

function.return_type: void, this function does not return anything

function.name: ImmCreateContext
function.description: This function creates a new input context and returns its handle.

parameters.name: void
parameters.description: This function does not take any parameters.

function.return_type: HIMC, which represents the handle to the newly created input context. If the creation fails, it returns 0.

function.name: IMM_DestroyContext
function.description: This function is used to destroy an input context. It first frees the input context data, if it fails to do so, it returns FALSE. If it succeeds, it destroys the input context and returns TRUE.

parameters.name: hIMC
parameters.description: This parameter is a handle to the input context that is to be destroyed.

function.return_type: BOOL, represents whether the input context was successfully destroyed or not. Returns TRUE if successful, FALSE otherwise.

function.name: ImmDestroyContext
function.description: This function destroys the specified input context. It checks if the input context is the default one for the thread or if it belongs to another thread, in which cases it does not destroy it and returns FALSE. Otherwise, it destroys the input context and returns the result of the operation.

parameters.name: hIMC
parameters.description: Handle to the input context to be destroyed.

function.return_type: BOOL, represents whether the input context was successfully destroyed or not. Returns FALSE if the input context is the default one for the thread or if it belongs to another thread, otherwise returns the result of the IMM_DestroyContext function.

function.name: ImmAssociateContext
function.description: This function associates a new input context with a window, retrieves the old input context, and handles focus change events.

parameters.name: hwnd
parameters.description: Handle to the window with which the input context is to be associated.

parameters.name: new_himc
parameters.description: Handle to the input context that is to be associated with the window.

function.return_type: HIMC, represents the old input context if the association was successful, or 0 if the association failed.

function.name: enum_associate_context
function.description: This function associates a specified input context with a specified window.

parameters.name: hwnd
parameters.description: Handle to the window to be associated with the input context.

parameters.name: lparam
parameters.description: Specifies the input context.

function.return_type: BOOL, returns TRUE always

function.name: ImmAssociateContextEx
function.description: This function associates a new input context with a window, and sets the active context according to the specified flags.

parameters.name: hwnd
parameters.description: Handle to the window with which the input context is to be associated.

parameters.name: new_himc
parameters.description: Handle to the input context to be associated with the window.

parameters.name: flags
parameters.description: Specifies how the input context is associated with the window.

function.return_type: BOOL, returns TRUE if the function succeeds, and FALSE otherwise.

function.name: enum_register_word_WtoA

parameters.name: readingW
parameters.description: Pointer to the wide character string to be converted and registered.

parameters.name: style
parameters.description: Style parameter for the registration process.

parameters.name: stringW
parameters.description: Another wide character string to be converted and registered.

parameters.name: user
parameters.description: Pointer to a structure that contains the procedure to register the converted strings and an additional user parameter.

function.return_type: int, represents the result of the registration process. Returns the value returned by the registration procedure.

function.name: ImmEnumRegisterWordA
function.description: This function is used to enumerate the registered words in the specified Input Method Editor (IME). It handles both Unicode and non-Unicode IMEs.

parameters.name: hkl
parameters.description: A handle to the input locale identifier

parameters.name: procA
parameters.description: A pointer to the callback function

parameters.name: readingA
parameters.description: A pointer to the reading string

parameters.name: style
parameters.description: The style of the registered words

parameters.name: stringA
parameters.description: A pointer to the registered string

parameters.name: user
parameters.description: A pointer to the user-defined data

function.return_type: UINT, represents the result of the function. If the function succeeds, the return value is non-zero. If the function fails, the return value is zero.

function.name: enum_register_word_AtoW
function.description: This function converts strings from ASCII to wide characters, calls a procedure with these converted strings and other parameters, and then frees the memory allocated for the converted strings.

parameters.name: readingA
parameters.description: An ASCII string to be converted to wide characters

parameters.name: style
parameters.description: A parameter to be passed to the procedure

parameters.name: stringA
parameters.description: Another ASCII string to be converted to wide characters

parameters.name: user
parameters.description: A pointer to a structure containing the procedure to be called and its parameters

function.return_type: int, represents the return value of the procedure called within the function

function.name: ImmEnumRegisterWordW
function.description: This function is used to enumerate the registered words in the specified Input Method Editor (IME). It acquires the IME, checks if it is Unicode, and then calls the IME's EnumRegisterWord function. If the IME is not Unicode, it converts the reading and string parameters from wide characters to multibyte characters before calling the EnumRegisterWord function.

parameters.name: hkl
parameters.description: A handle to the input locale identifier

parameters.name: procW
parameters.description: A pointer to the callback function

parameters.name: readingW
parameters.description: A pointer to the reading string

parameters.name: style
parameters.description: The style of the registered words to enumerate

parameters.name: stringW
parameters.description: A pointer to the string of the registered word

parameters.name: user
parameters.description: A pointer to the user-defined data

function.return_type: UINT. It represents the result of the enumeration. If the function succeeds, the return value is a non-zero value. If the function fails, the return value is zero.

function.name: EscapeRequiresWA
function.description: This function checks if the input parameter matches any of the predefined constants. If it does, the function returns TRUE, otherwise it returns FALSE.

parameters.name: uEscape
parameters.description: This parameter is checked against predefined constants.

function.return_type: BOOL, represents whether the input parameter matches any of the predefined constants.

function.name: ImmEscapeA
function.description: This function is used to process various escape sequences for Input Method Manager (IMM). It handles different codes and data inputs, and performs different actions based on these inputs.

parameters.name: hkl
parameters.description: A handle to the keyboard layout

parameters.name: himc
parameters.description: A handle to the input context

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: The escape function to be performed

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: A pointer to the data to be processed

function.return_type: LRESULT, represents the result of the escape function. If the function fails, the return value is zero.

function.name: ImmEscapeW
function.description: This function is used to process various escape sequences. It acquires an IME (Input Method Editor), checks if the escape requires wide characters or if the IME is unicode or if data is not null. If any of these conditions are met, it calls the IME escape function. If not, it checks if the code is set to IME_ESC_SET_EUDC_DICTIONARY, converts wide characters to multibyte characters and calls the IME escape function. If the code is not set to IME_ESC_SET_EUDC_DICTIONARY, it calls the IME escape function and converts multibyte characters to wide characters.

parameters.name: hkl
parameters.description: Handle to the input locale identifier

parameters.name: himc
parameters.description: Handle to the input context

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: Unsigned integer representing the escape function to be performed

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: Pointer to the data to be processed

function.return_type: LRESULT, represents the result of the escape function. If the IME could not be acquired, it returns 0.

function.name: ImmGetCandidateListA
function.description: This function retrieves the candidate list for an Input Method Manager (IMM) context.

parameters.name: hIMC
parameters.description: Handle to the input context

parameters.name: dwIndex
parameters.description: Index of the candidate list

parameters.name: lpCandList
parameters.description: Pointer to a buffer that receives the candidate list

parameters.name: dwBufLen
parameters.description: Size, in bytes, of the buffer pointed to by lpCandList

function.return_type: DWORD. The function returns the size, in bytes, of the written candidate list. If the function fails, it returns 0.

function.name: ImmGetCandidateListCountA
function.description: This function retrieves the number of candidate lists for an Input Method Manager context and returns the size of the candidate list.

parameters.description: Handle to the input context.

parameters.name: lpdwListCount
parameters.description: Pointer to a variable that receives the number of candidate lists.

function.return_type: DWORD, represents the size of the candidate list. If the function fails, it returns 0.

function.name: ImmGetCandidateListCountW
function.description: This function retrieves the count of candidate lists and the size of the candidate list for a specified input context.

parameters.name: hIMC
parameters.description: Handle to the input context.

parameters.name: lpdwListCount
parameters.description: Pointer to a variable that receives the number of candidate lists.

function.return_type: DWORD, represents the size of the candidate list. If the function fails, it returns 0.

function.description: This function retrieves the candidate list for an Input Method Editor (IME). It locks the IMCC, checks the index and the candidate list, and then either copies the candidate list to the buffer or converts it from ANSI to wide characters, depending on the IME. It then unlocks the IMCC and returns the size of the candidate list or the result of the conversion.

parameters.name: hIMC
parameters.description: Handle to the input context

parameters.name: dwIndex
parameters.description: Index of the candidate list

parameters.name: lpCandList
parameters.description: Pointer to a buffer that receives the candidate list

parameters.name: dwBufLen
parameters.description: Size, in bytes, of the buffer pointed to by lpCandList

function.return_type: DWORD, represents the size, in bytes, of the candidate list. If the function fails, it returns zero.

function.name: ImmGetCandidateWindow
function.description: This function retrieves the candidate window information for the specified input context.

parameters.name: himc
parameters.description: Handle to the input context.

parameters.name: index
parameters.description: Index of the candidate list.

parameters.name: candidate
parameters.description: Pointer to a CANDIDATEFORM structure that receives the candidate window information.

function.return_type: BOOL, returns TRUE if the function succeeds, FALSE if it fails or if the specified index does not exist.

function.name: ImmGetCompositionFontA
function.description: This function retrieves the logical font information for the current composition window based on the input context information. It handles both ANSI and Unicode input contexts.

parameters.name: himc
